sources.excerpt: SiClops (Klone) | Circuit Rider Studios Our Work Production Exclusive Tracks About Us Contact CRFX Cart My account Checkout Select Page Home  /  Uncategorized  / SiClops (Klone) SiClops (Klone) $ 119.99 Based on the highly sought-after, mythical, gold, transparent overdrive pedal, our version is slightly modified. We have added “chime” and a “grind” mode accessible via the 3 way toggle switch. This is an excellent first gain stage for any pedalboard. It also shines as a boost or for stacking into other drive pedals. SiClops (Klone) quantity Add to cart Category: Uncategorized Description Description This is a great first-stage Overdrive pedal. Some players keep it as an always-on-core tone at the heart of their rig. Switch into chime mode and use it as a boost to smash the front end of your tube amp. This pedal is even more versatile than the original. In grind mode, it can be used as a medium overdrive also working great to add some top-end sear to flatter, darker sounding tube amps.
